phases.title: Algorithms
phases.subject: algorithms

focus.text: BFS and DFS: valid orders, edge types, timings, trees, topological sort
MST: cut and cycle properties, Kruskal and Prim orders, counting MSTs
Recurrences and asymptotics: master theorem, square-root recurrences, loops
Sorting: swaps, passes and comparisons, quick and merge sort traces, lower bounds
DP: fill order, LCS, knapsack and subset sum, matrix chain, Bellman-Ford, Floyd-Warshall
Greedy: Huffman, activity selection, optimal merge. Searching: binary search variants

skip: P, NP and NP-complete (off the syllabus: one line only)

phases.title: Digital Logic
phases.subject: digital-logic

focus.text: Number representation: 2's complement range and overflow, IEEE 754 single precision
Minimisation: K-maps, prime and essential prime implicants, don't-cares, tabular method
Counters: mod-N, ripple vs synchronous, trace the sequence
MUX as a function, decoders, adders and carry-lookahead delay
Flip-flops: characteristic tables and conversions

phases.title: Computer Organization & Architecture
phases.subject: coa

focus.text: Cache: mapping, tag/index/offset bits, hit ratio, AMAT, write-back vs write-through
Pipelining: speedup, CPI with stalls, hazards, forwarding, branch penalty
Instruction formats and addressing modes (opcode bit counting)
Control unit: hardwired vs microprogrammed, control-word size
I/O: interrupts, DMA burst vs cycle stealing, % of CPU time
Memory interfacing and interleaving

skip: Secondary storage and disks (dropped from the 2027 syllabus)

phases.title: Computer Networks
phases.subject: computer-networks

focus.text: IPv4: CIDR, subnetting, longest prefix match, fragmentation, NAT
TCP: congestion window (slow start, AIMD, threshold), flow control, sequence numbers
Sliding window: stop-and-wait, Go-Back-N, Selective Repeat efficiency and sequence bits
Data link: error detection (CRC), CSMA/CD minimum frame size, Ethernet
Switching and performance: transmission and propagation delay, throughput
Routing: distance vector (count to infinity), link state
Layering, socket API, DNS and HTTP (light)

skip: Not in the 2027 syllabus: UDP, ARP, DHCP, ICMP, SMTP, FTP, email
